packages.title: Kashi Awakening: Ganga Aarti Retreat
packages.summary: Sunrise boat rides, Kashi Vishwanath darshan and front-row seats at the Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti.
packages.description: Experience the oldest living city with a local priest-guide. Walk the ghats at dawn, take part in a Rudrabhishek, explore Sarnath and end each day with the fire ritual on the Ganga.
highlights: Private sunrise boat on the Ganga

itinerary.title: Arrival and evening Aarti
itinerary.description: Pick-up from airport/station, check in and witness the Ganga Aarti from a reserved boat.

itinerary.title: Sunrise boat and darshan
itinerary.description: Dawn boat ride past 84 ghats, Kashi Vishwanath darshan, old-city walk.

itinerary.title: Sarnath and Rudrabhishek
itinerary.description: Visit Sarnath where the Buddha gave his first sermon; evening Rudrabhishek puja.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning meditation on the ghats and drop-off.

packages.title: Rishikesh Yoga & Meditation Immersion
packages.summary: A week of Hatha yoga, pranayama and guided meditation in an ashram by the Ganga.
packages.description: Reset body and mind with twice-daily yoga, Vedic philosophy talks, sound healing, a forest trek to Kunjapuri for sunrise and evening Aarti at Parmarth Niketan.

itinerary.title: Arrive and settle
itinerary.description: Welcome circle, gentle evening yoga and Aarti.

itinerary.title: Foundations

itinerary.description: Pre-dawn drive and short trek to the Kunjapuri temple for sunrise over the Himalaya.

itinerary.title: Silence day
itinerary.description: A day of mauna (silence) with walking meditation.

itinerary.title: Sound and breath
itinerary.description: Sound healing, kirtan night.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls and caves
itinerary.description: Hike to Neer Garh waterfall and Vashishta Gufa meditation cave.

itinerary.title: Closing ceremony
itinerary.description: Fire ceremony, certificates and departure.

packages.title: Do Dham Yatra: Kedarnath & Badrinath
packages.summary: Himalayan pilgrimage to two of the holiest shrines, with helicopter option for Kedarnath.
packages.description: A carefully paced yatra from Haridwar through Guptkashi to Kedarnath and on to Badrinath and Mana, India's last village. Includes registration, ponies on request and oxygen support.
highlights: Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Drive along the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers.

itinerary.title: Trek to Kedarnath
itinerary.description: Trek 16 km from Gaurikund, evening darshan.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Morning puja and trek down.

itinerary.title: To Badrinath
itinerary.description: Drive via Chopta and Joshimath.

itinerary.description: Temple darshan, Tapt Kund, Mana village.

itinerary.title: Return to Haridwar
itinerary.description: Drive back with stop at Devprayag confluence.

packages.title: Footsteps of the Buddha
packages.summary: Vipassana sessions under the Bodhi tree, Rajgir, Nalanda ruins and the Vulture Peak.
packages.description: Guided by a Buddhist scholar, sit in meditation at the Mahabodhi temple, explore the ancient university of Nalanda and climb Vulture Peak where the Buddha taught the Heart Sutra.

packages.title: Golden Temple Seva Journey
packages.summary: Do seva in the world's largest community kitchen and witness the Palki Sahib ceremony.
packages.description: Stay near Harmandir Sahib, volunteer in the langar, attend the night Palki Sahib ceremony and visit Jallianwala Bagh and the Wagah border.

itinerary.description: Amrit Vela prayers at dawn and drop-off.

packages.title: Tirumala Balaji Special Darshan
packages.summary: Hassle-free special-entry darshan of Sri Venkateswara with Padmavathi temple visit.
packages.description: We handle tickets, accommodation and transfers so you can focus on darshan. Includes Tiruchanur Padmavathi temple and Kapila Theertham.

packages.summary: Darshan at Jagannath Dham, Konark at sunrise and Chilika lake dolphins.
packages.description: One of the four Char Dhams on the seashore. Taste the Mahaprasad, visit Konark at sunrise and the Lingaraj temple in Bhubaneswar.

packages.title: Ramayana Trail: Rameswaram & Dhanushkodi
packages.summary: Holy bath in 22 theerthams, the pillared corridors and Dhanushkodi's land's end.
packages.description: Follow the Ramayana: bathe in the 22 sacred wells of Ramanathaswamy temple, visit Dhanushkodi where the two seas meet and the Pamban bridge.
